intro: A mix of Vietnamese and international teachers. Every academic teacher has a degree in their subject, teaching experience and a TESOL certificate, and is qualified to teach in Việt Nam.
note: Bios describe what each person teaches and leads in 2026-27, from the timetable. Add personal background (home country, degrees, years at PRA) when ready.

members.name: Mr. Seth
members.bio: From California, teaching in Việt Nam for a decade, with a Bachelor's in Health Science and certification as a biology teacher for grades 7 to 12. Runs the kitchen on cooking days, Art of Science for Secondary, and one of the Teens blocks. If your child comes home smelling of garlic, that was Seth.

members.name: Mr. Bowen
members.bio: Year 7's homeroom teacher and their Maths and Science teacher, plus a Teens block. Bowen also runs the school office side of PRA, so he is usually the first person you will hear from about admissions, fees and reports.

members.name: Mr. David
members.bio: Homeroom for the Teens class, where every student follows their own diploma or Cambridge program with David beside them. Teaches Year 7 English and Year 5 Maths, runs the Maker Space, and is the school counselor.

members.name: Mr. Caleb
members.bio: Homeroom for Years 2 and 3 and their English, Maths and Science teacher in the mornings. In the afternoons he teaches Technology, Art and Craft and Everyday Experts to Years 2 to 5, Dance, and Movement for Year 7.

members.name: Ms. Kiu
members.bio: Homeroom for Year 5 and their English and Science teacher. Also teaches History and Executive Function to Year 7, Wellbeing to every class from Year 2 to Teens, and Literacy to the Kindergarten.

members.name: Ms. Solo
members.bio: Homeroom for Year 1 and their English, Maths and Science teacher, plus Practice, Presentation and Play. Also takes the Nursery's afternoon session, so she meets most children before they ever reach Year 1.

members.name: Ms. Thanh
members.bio: Homeroom for the Kindergarten. Starts every day outside, then phonics and maths, and after lunch Understanding the World, which is science and geography for four-year-olds.

members.name: Ms. Tham
members.bio: Homeroom for the Nursery, our youngest group. Leads the morning learning time with Ms. Thoa and writes the Nursery progress reports.

members.name: Ms. Thoa
members.bio: The second teacher in the Nursery room all day, from drop-off through the afternoon session. Two adults for the smallest children is the point.

members.name: Ms. Thắm V
members.bio: Teaches Craft and Technology to Years 2 to 5 in the afternoons, runs Review sessions and the class called Boredom, and looks after the cafeteria at lunch.

members.name: Ms. Duyen
members.bio: Teaches Technology and Crafts to Year 1 and is on the gate every morning at drop-off. Also part of the school office team.

members.name: Mr. Chiến
members.bio: Movement and Exercise for Year 1 and Years 2 to 5: structured sport, fitness and free play on the turf, twice a week for every class.
